Data Engineer Lead at NexaFlow Solutions, with four years of shaping data infrastructure in the SaaS sector. My focus is on building systems that turn raw data into actionable insights, while ensuring scalability and reliability.  

At NexaFlow, I’ve designed end-to-end data pipelines leveraging Kafka for real-time streaming and Spark for batch processing, integrating with Snowflake to power analytics. Ownership of Snowflake warehouses led to a 40% reduction in query latency, enabling faster decision-making. AWS serves as the backbone for our cloud infrastructure, where I’ve automated deployments using Terraform and streamlined workflows with Docker.  

Apache Airflow is central to my work—its orchestration capabilities underpin our data operations, and I’ve mentored teams to adopt it as a standard. I thrive in environments where data engineering meets business needs, ensuring solutions are both robust and adaptable.  

Looking ahead, I’m driven by the challenge of aligning technical innovation with strategic goals. Whether optimizing pipelines or scaling architectures, the goal is always to deliver value without compromise. Let’s connect if you’re navigating the complexities of data-driven growth.
